name: Thompson Austin
positioning: Design-led downtown Austin tower hotel at 5th and San Jacinto with a 4th-floor rooftop pool deck and Mexican rooftop cantina, sharing the building with the tommie boutique hotel
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Austin base with a rooftop pool and lively bars
Guests wanting a multi-room Upper Stories suite with a kitchen

facts.text: Thompson Austin sits above 5th and San Jacinto in downtown Austin, in a 32-story sustainable development.
All accommodations have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views, hardwood floors, leather furnishings, cast concrete and stone mosaics.
Rooms have D.S. & Durga bath amenities and rainfall showers.
The lobby has rich leather furnishings, a monolithic fireplace and petrified wood ceilings.
Arriba Abajo is a Mexican rooftop restaurant and bar with downtown Austin views.
The Royale Room is a seventies-inspired cocktail lounge known for martinis.
Fifth Street Diner is a classic American-style diner serving all-day staples such as omelets and a smash burger.
The Coffee Bar serves coffee from Texas Coffee Roasters.
The fitness center covers over 6,700 square feet with Peloton bikes, Technogym treadmills and a private studio space.
The hotel has a Full Swing sports simulator.
Dogs stay at no additional charge, with a maximum of two pets.
The hotel has LEED Silver certification and is an Austin Energy Green Building.

highlights.text: Tommie, a separate boutique hotel, sits within Thompson Austin and shares its amenities.
On Thursday nights Arriba Abajo offers an omakase-inspired dinner paired with mezcals and mezcal cocktails.
The pool deck is on the 4th floor, with cabanas, daybeds and loungers.
The Upper Stories suites are on the topmost floor; guests can arrange pre-arrival grocery stocking for the kitchens, in-room massage and wellness treatments through a personal VIP concierge.
The five event spaces are named after Texas outlaws: Kelley, Red River, Singer, Newton and Bass.

considerations.text: A daily destination fee applies to each room; it includes use of hotel cruiser bikes, based on availability.
Austin-Bergstrom International Airport is about 9 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes typical city noise levels in this urban location.
